# Cinou AI

> Cinou AI is a free, unlimited multi-model AI assistant with an agentic task workspace, plus Cinou Coder, a browser and terminal coding assistant. There are no credits or daily caps inside the app. Developers can call Cinou through an OpenAI-compatible API using a CINOUAI_API_KEY.

## Product
- [Cinou AI (chat app)](https://cinouai.onrender.com/): chat, tasks, file and image understanding, memory, voice, desktop and mobile layouts.
- [Cinou Coder](https://cinouai.onrender.com/coder): web coding workspace with live HTML/CSS/JS preview, explain/fix/refactor actions, and a downloadable terminal CLI.
- [About Cinou AI](https://cinouai.onrender.com/about): full description of models, effort levels, architecture, API and FAQ.

## Models
- Apex 5 — flagship, for the hardest problems (default effort: high)
- Apex 5 Think — deep step-by-step reasoning (default effort: max)
- C1 4.5 — complex work and everyday tasks (default effort: medium)
- C1 Coder — tuned for code generation and debugging
- Spark 3 — default, efficient for most tasks
- C Lite 2 — fastest, for quick answers
- Legacy: Spark 2.5, C Lite 1

Effort levels: low, medium, high, max. Higher effort = longer, more careful answers.

## API
- `GET /v1/models` — list models
- `POST /v1/chat/completions` — OpenAI-compatible chat (supports `stream: true` and `effort`)
- Auth: `Authorization: Bearer $CINOUAI_API_KEY`
- Keys are created at /api-keys.html; the server stores only SHA-256 hashes.
